assertions: Task203 implements native ScHorizontalCellIterator row-major traversal over actual shared mdds const block cursors,with original column-parameter vector,SkipInvalidInRow/FindNextNonEmptyRow order,stable borrowed result owner,inclusive area bounds and original allocated-column clamp.
